optimizer.name: Q1
optimizer.ra: π name, subject_name, marks (σ students.student_id = result.student_id ∧ result.subject_id = subject.subject_id ∧ marks >= 90 (students × result × subject))
optimizer.opt: π name, subject_name, marks (students ⋈[students.student_id = result.student_id] σ marks >= 90 (result) ⋈[result.subject_id = subject.subject_id] subject)

optimizer.name: Q2
optimizer.ra: π name, dept_name (σ students.dept_id = department.dept_id ∧ gender='Female' (students × department))
optimizer.opt: π name, dept_name (σ gender='Female' (students) ⋈[students.dept_id = department.dept_id] department)

optimizer.name: Q3
optimizer.ra: π students.name, subject.subject_name (σ grade='A' (students ⋈ result ⋈ subject))
optimizer.opt: π students.name, subject.subject_name (students ⋈ σ grade='A' (result) ⋈ subject)

optimizer.opt: π City (σ City='Bhopal' (Owners)) ∪ π City (σ City='Bhopal' (Pets))

translations.sql: SELECT DISTINCT name FROM students LEFT JOIN mentor ON students.student_id = mentor.student_id WHERE mentor.student_id IS NULL
translations.en: Show the name of students left-outer-joined with mentor where students.student_id is mentor.student_id, keeping every row of students even without a match (missing values are empty) where mentor.student_id IS NULL.

translations.ra: π OID, City (Owns ⨝ π PetID, City (Pets)) ÷ π City (Pets)
translations.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT L1."OID"
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OID, City FROM Owns NATURAL JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PetID, City FROM Pets) AS Pets) AS L1
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT R."City" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT City FROM Pets) AS R
    EXCEPT
    SELECT L2."City" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OID, City FROM Owns NATURAL JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PetID, City FROM Pets) AS Pets) AS L2 WHERE L2."OID" = L1."OID"
)
translations.en: Show the values in the OID and City of Owns combined with the PetID and City of Pets on their matching common columns that are paired with every row of the City of Pets.
